caption: The drawing depicts a pair of brown ankle-high button boots positioned on a plain beige background. One boot stands upright, displaying the outside view with a row of seven large round buttons running along the side, as well as a decorative tassel attached near the top. The other boot lies on its side, showing the sole and heel as well as the same button and tassel detail. The boots have a moderate, slightly chunky heel and a curved shape at the toes. The shading and color rendering on the boots suggest they are made of leather, with darker and lighter brown tones used to indicate highlights, creases, and wear. The background is unadorned, placing full focus on the pair of boots. At the bottom right, the text "ALEXANDER ANDERSON - 1940 -" is written in small, neat letters.
title: Child's Shoe
